---
title: "In-class exercise: Bayesian imputation for a split-plot Design"
format: html
---

In this exercise, we analyze a split-plot experiment investigating the effects of **fungicide** (`fung`, whole-plot factor) and **genotype** (`gen`, subplot factor) on crop **yield** (`yield`), arranged in randomized complete blocks (`block`).

We will take `df`, artificially remove random yield observations (missing completely at random - MCAR), and use **Bayesian imputation** in Stan (`cmdstanr`) to jointly estimate the fixed/random effects and impute the missing yields.

### 1. Load packages, inspect data, and induce missingness (MCAR)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(cmdstanr)
library(bayesplot)
library(ggpubr)

df_complete <- agridat::durban.splitplot
df <- agridat::durban.splitplot
set.seed(42)
missing_idx <- sample(1:nrow(df), size = round(0.02 * nrow(df)), replace = FALSE)
df$yield[missing_idx] <- NA

df |>
  filter(is.na(yield))
```

### 2. Fit the reference `lmer` model (Complete Case / Listwise Deletion)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fit_lmer_cc <- lmer(yield ~ fung * gen + (1 | block) + (1 | block:fung), data = df)
summary(fit_lmer_cc)
```

### 3. Bayesian Imputation in Stan

Following the lecture workflow, we construct an index vector `y_missing` that maps each missing observation to its corresponding parameter in the `y_impute` vector inside Stan.

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
stan_code_splitplot <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  int<lower=1> K;                      // Number of fixed-effect parameters
  matrix[N, K] X;                      // Fixed-effects design matrix (fung * gen)
  int<lower=1> N_block;                // Number of blocks
  int<lower=1> N_wp;                   // Number of whole-plots (block:fung)
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=N_block> block_id;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=N_wp> wp_id;
  
  int<lower=0> y_num_missing;          // Count of missing yield observations
  vector[N] y;                         // Yield vector (NAs replaced with 0)
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=y_num_missing> y_missing; // Running index of NAs
}

parameters {
  vector[K] beta;                      // Fixed effects
  real<lower=0> sigma_block;           // Block SD
  real<lower=0> sigma_wp;              // Whole-plot SD (block:fung)
  real<lower=0> sigma_eps;             // Subplot / residual SD
  
  vector[N_block] z_block;             // Non-centered block random effects
  vector[N_wp] z_wp;                   // Non-centered whole-plot random effects
  
  vector[y_num_missing] y_impute;      // Imputed values for missing yields
}

transformed parameters {
  vector[N_block] b_block = sigma_block * z_block;
  vector[N_wp] b_wp = sigma_wp * z_wp;
  vector[N] y_merged;                  // Combined observed + imputed yields
  vector[N] mu;

  for (i in 1:N) {
    mu[i] = dot_product(X[i], beta) + b_block[block_id[i]] + b_wp[wp_id[i]];
    if (y_missing[i] > 0) {
      y_merged[i] = y_impute[y_missing[i]];
    } else {
      y_merged[i] = y[i];
    }
  }
}

model {
  // Priors
  beta[1] ~ normal(50, 25);
  beta[2:K] ~ normal(0, 10);
  sigma_block ~ exponential(0.5);
  sigma_wp ~ exponential(0.5);
  sigma_eps ~ exponential(0.5);
  
  z_block ~ std_normal();
  z_wp ~ std_normal();

  // Joint likelihood over observed and imputed yields
  y_merged ~ normal(mu, sigma_eps);
}
"

BI_splitplot_model <- cmdstan_model(write_stan_file(stan_code_splitplot))

# Create running index for missing observations
y_missing <- as.numeric(is.na(df$yield))
y_missing <- sapply(1:length(y_missing),
                    function(n) y_missing[n] * sum(y_missing[1:n]))
y_missing

# Build design matrix without dropping NAs
options(na.action = "na.pass")
X <- model.matrix(~ fung * gen, data = df)
options(na.action = "na.omit")

wp_factor <- interaction(df$block, df$fung, drop = TRUE)

stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(df),
  K = ncol(X),
  X = X,
  N_block = length(unique(df$block)),
  N_wp = length(levels(wp_factor)),
  block_id = as.numeric(factor(df$block)),
  wp_id = as.numeric(wp_factor),
  y_num_missing = sum(is.na(df$yield)),
  y = replace_na(df$yield, 0),
  y_missing = y_missing
)

samples <- BI_splitplot_model$sample(
  data = stan_data,
  seed = 33,
  chains = 3,
  parallel_chains = 3,
  iter_warmup = 1500,
  iter_sampling = 1000,
  refresh = 0
)

mcmc_trace(samples$draws(c("beta[1]", "beta[2]", "sigma_block", "sigma_wp", "sigma_eps")))
mcmc_pairs(samples$draws(c("sigma_block", "sigma_wp", "sigma_eps")))
```

### 4. Extract Imputed Values and Visualize Uncertainty

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Summarize fixed effects and variance components
fitted_params <- samples$summary(c("beta", "sigma_block", "sigma_wp", "sigma_eps"))
fitted_params

# Extract posterior means and SDs for imputed datapoints
y_imputed <- samples$summary() |>
  filter(str_detect(variable, "y_impute"))

y_imputed_mean <- c(NA, y_imputed$mean)
y_imputed_sd <- c(NA, y_imputed$sd)

merged_data <- df |>
  mutate(
    y_missing_id = factor(y_missing),
    yield_true = df_complete$yield,
    yield_merged = ifelse(is.na(yield),
                          y_imputed_mean[y_missing_id],
                          yield),
    yield_sd = ifelse(is.na(yield),
                      y_imputed_sd[y_missing_id],
                      NA)
  )

# Plot observed data alongside Bayesian imputed values (+/- 1 posterior SD)
merged_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gen, y = yield_merged, color = fung)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = yield_merged - yield_sd, ymax = yield_merged + yield_sd),
    width = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = (y_missing == 0)),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("white", "grey20"),
    labels = c("Imputed (with ±1 SD)", "Observed"),
    name = "Data Status"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~block, labeller = label_both) +
  theme_pubclean() +
  labs(
    title = "Split-Plot Yield: Observed vs. Bayesian Imputed Values",
    x = "Genotype (Subplot)",
    y = expression(Yield~merged~(bu~ac^{-1})),
    color = "Fungicide"
  )
```

```{r}
merged_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yield_true, y = yield_merged, color = factor(y_missing_id))) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = yield_merged - yield_sd, ymax = yield_merged + yield_sd),
    width = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = (y_missing == 0)),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("white", "grey20"),
    labels = c("Imputed (with ±1 SD)", "Observed"),
    name = "Data Status"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~block, labeller = label_both) +
  theme_pubclean() +
  labs(
    title = "Split-Plot Yield: Observed vs. Bayesian Imputed Values",
    x = "Genotype (Subplot)",
    y = expression(Yield~merged~(bu~ac^{-1})),
    color = "Fungicide"
  )
```

### 5. What if we didn't impute and just dropped those rows?

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
stan_code_small <- "
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  int<lower=1> K;
  matrix[N, K] X;
  int<lower=1> N_block;
  int<lower=1> N_wp;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=N_block> block_id;
  array[N] int<lower=1, upper=N_wp> wp_id;
  vector[N] y;
}

parameters {
  vector[K] beta;
  real<lower=0> sigma_block;
  real<lower=0> sigma_wp;
  real<lower=0> sigma_eps;
  vector[N_block] z_block;
  vector[N_wp] z_wp;
}

transformed parameters {
  vector[N_block] b_block = sigma_block * z_block;
  vector[N_wp] b_wp = sigma_wp * z_wp;
  vector[N] mu;

  for (i in 1:N) {
    mu[i] = dot_product(X[i], beta) + b_block[block_id[i]] + b_wp[wp_id[i]];
  }
}

model {
  beta[1] ~ normal(50, 25);
  beta[2:K] ~ normal(0, 10);
  sigma_block ~ exponential(0.5);
  sigma_wp ~ exponential(0.5);
  sigma_eps ~ exponential(0.5);
  
  z_block ~ std_normal();
  z_wp ~ std_normal();

  y ~ normal(mu, sigma_eps);
}
"

small_splitplot_model <- cmdstan_model(write_stan_file(stan_code_small))

df_small <- drop_na(df)
X_small <- model.matrix(~ fung * gen, data = df_small)
wp_factor_small <- interaction(df_small$block, df_small$fung, drop = TRUE)

stan_data_small <- list(
  N = nrow(df_small),
  K = ncol(X_small),
  X = X_small,
  N_block = length(unique(df_small$block)),
  N_wp = length(levels(wp_factor_small)),
  block_id = as.numeric(factor(df_small$block)),
  wp_id = as.numeric(wp_factor_small),
  y = df_small$yield
)

samples_small <- small_splitplot_model$sample(
  data = stan_data_small,
  seed = 33,
  chains = 3,
  parallel_chains = 3,
  iter_warmup = 1500,
  iter_sampling = 1000,
  refresh = 0
)

# Compare parameter estimates: Imputed Model vs. Dropped-NA Model
bind_rows(
  samples$summary(c("beta", "sigma_block", "sigma_wp", "sigma_eps")) |> mutate(Model = "Full Bayesian Imputation"),
  samples_small$summary(c("beta", "sigma_block", "sigma_wp", "sigma_eps")) |> mutate(Model = "Dropped NAs (Complete Case)")
) |>
  select(Model, variable, mean, sd, q5, q95) |>
  arrange(variable, Model)
```
